params.query: DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.crm.customers` WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(contracts) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(contracts) AS x WHERE x.end_date IS NULL OR x.end_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2555 DAY))
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.crm.customers__quarantine` WHERE _quarantined_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2555 DAY)
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.crm.support_tickets` WHERE opened_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 730 DAY)
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.crm.support_tickets__quarantine` WHERE _quarantined_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 730 DAY)
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.finance.billing__quarantine` WHERE _quarantined_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 3650 DAY)
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.network.network_events__quarantine` WHERE _quarantined_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
DELETE FROM `${var.project_id}.network.usage_events__quarantine` WHERE _quarantined_at < TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 180 DAY)

principals.description: Seat -> IAM member (user:, group: or serviceAccount:). No default: a seat with no principal is a failed plan, never an invented one (doctrine 3). Seats come from contracts/_roles.yaml and, for roles bound to a contract field (steward, custodian), from each contract.

validation.error_message: principals must bind every seat: analyst@DE, analyst@GR, analyst@IT, bi_service, fraud_investigator, group:crm-stewards@halverra.example, group:data-governance@halverra.example, group:data-platform@halverra.example, group:finance-stewards@halverra.example, group:network-stewards@halverra.example.
every principal is user:, group: or serviceAccount:.
every custodian runs the scheduled retention DELETEs, so it must be a service account: group:data-platform@halverra.example.
